bio.text: Samuel Ronan is a write-in independent candidate for Ohio's 15th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.

According to Ballotpedia's profile, which draws on candidate-provided information, he is a U.S. Air Force veteran with an associate degree from the Community College of the Air Force (2011) and has worked in manufacturing.
Ballotpedia also notes that Ronan was a candidate for chair of the Democratic National Committee in 2017.
